reason: The knob is live, but it is a closed idea under another name. Live: exp70g cell 0 l.35 sets BIOHUB_SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM=2.25, cell 2 l.148 reads it, and c7 l.1605 is its only use (gate order parent -> sister -> mutual NN -> divergence -> DC 0.25 -> tau). Cell 3 does not re-set it. The ppsweep pp_apply runs only with VALIDATOR_ENABLE=1, and exp70g sets 0. safetail keeps safe divisions after the deadline and divinsert runs after this gate without bypassing it. On the visible-test log (runtime_step0/exp57b) safe forks were 35/6/5/16 with cap_skipped=0, so the caps do not bind and the gate moves forks 1:1. Nodes and runtime stay about flat. Why it is refuted: (1) I-333 (divergence 2.5/2.75) was rejected in R13, and R19-RC-B upheld the closure with R19-A10(c) 'out of every 28-29 Sep table'. The down direction (1.50) already sits as the last-rank W4 filler I-442. (2) It filters the same safe-division fork pool as the closed DeepCenter safe-div gate, whose public reads cover both directions: fewer safe forks (DC 0.30) 0.949 vs K2 0.954, more safe forks (DC 0.20/0.225) 0.954, flat. (3) UP arm: GT geometry puts 4 of 35 reachable real divisions in [2.25,2.5), an implied precision of ~0.37, above the 0.265 break-even, so removal is expected <= 0. (4) DOWN arm: the round-13 div1.75 lab (DC-blind) gained 0 TP for +620 forks. The '75/151 GT divisions rejected by the divergence gate' count is mostly structural rejections (no single t+2 successor), which lowering the threshold cannot recover, and the arm's size is DC-blind (I-419). The proposer's own prior is low. Expected outcome of the pair: UP negative, DOWN ~0. Not worth two of the last public slots.
fixed_values: Only if overruled: UP 2.5 (the lab-clean rung; 2.75 moves further into TP territory) and DOWN 2.0 (keeps the fork add under ~+15 instead of the DC-blind +10..+30 at 1.75).
build_line: Not recommended (refuted). If overruled: UP: --set SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM=2.5 | DOWN: --set SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM=2.0 (both --base x138 on the exp70g recipe)
